sourceText: The user asked: 那你写一个执行方案吧, referring to the reviewed proposal for migrating Proof-or-stop AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md into thin host entrypoints, adding a verified operational runbook, and migrating hard-coded CLAUDE.md consumers.
normalizedOutcome: A committed, navigable execution-plan decision document tells maintainers exactly how to migrate the Claude-first documentation contract to host-neutral thin entrypoints through ordered, test-first, reversible implementation Stories, while this Story itself changes no runtime or entrypoint behavior.
acceptanceClaim: The new decision document and NAV entry jointly contain the target hierarchy, exhaustive consumer migration categories, red/green test matrix, staged Story sequence, compatibility and rollback rules, and an unambiguous B-e514 convergence path.
